Assemble Gene-Centric Coding-Mask Results Genome-Wide

Source: R/aggregate_coding_results.R
aggregate_coding_results.Rd

Combines the per-chromosome output of a gene-centric coding-mask scan into one genome-wide table and computes its significance. It reads up to three result sources a coding run produces – GLOW's own results, and (optionally) STAARpipeline's STAAR-O results run without and with the saddlepoint approximation (SPA) – joins them by gene and variant category into a side-by-side method comparison, and derives per-category and genome-wide significance from the p-values. This is the coding-mask counterpart of aggregate_scan_results.

aggregate_coding_results(
  output_dir,
  chroms,
  gene_num_in_array,
  staar_modes = c("spa", "nospa"),
  genes_info = NULL,
  alpha = 0.05,
  gw_alpha = 2.5e-06,
  primary_test = "GLOW_Omni",
  allow_partial = FALSE,
  result_prefix = "glow_coding",
  type_label = "coding",
  family_alpha = NULL,
  gene_anchor = NULL,
  reference_cutoffs = NULL
)

Arguments

output_dir

Character. The run's outputs/ directory; the function reads results-glow/, results-staar-<mode>/ under it.

chroms

Integer vector of the chromosomes the run covered (the GLOW completeness denominator, e.g. config$chroms).

gene_num_in_array

Integer. Genes per native STAAR array task (the native array-task mapping, e.g. config$gene_num_in_array); used only to reconcile native completeness.

staar_modes

Character vector of native modes to read (default c("spa", "nospa"); pass character(0) for a GLOW-only run).

genes_info

Optional data frame whose second column gives each gene's chromosome (the STAARpipeline::genes_info layout). Used ONLY to derive the native array-task completeness denominator when staar_modes is non-empty; pass STAARpipeline::genes_info (or an equivalent table) to enable native reconciliation. Not needed for GLOW-only aggregation (staar_modes = character(0)) – the package has no hard dependency on STAARpipeline.

alpha

Family-wise error rate for the per-category Bonferroni cutoff (default 0.05).

gw_alpha

Genome-wide significance threshold (default 2.5e-6, the STAARpipeline convention).

primary_test

Column ranking the significant-cells table and driving the within-category order (default "GLOW_Omni").

allow_partial

Logical (default FALSE). When FALSE, a missing GLOW chromosome file or native array task is an error; when TRUE it is a warning and the assembly proceeds on the present files.

result_prefix

Character. The stem of the per-chromosome GLOW files under results-glow/: "glow_coding" (default) reads glow_coding_chr<N>.csv; "glow_noncoding" reads the gene-centric non-coding masks' tables.

type_label

Character. Names the returned tables: "coding" (default) gives glow_coding_all, coding_merged, coding_sig_by_category, coding_sig_by_category_cells; "noncoding" the same with that word.

family_alpha

Numeric or NULL (default). When given, the across-family cutoff is computed as family_alpha / n_all, with n_all the tested cells of the method over all categories, in place of the fixed gw_alpha; both denominators are reported in thresholds.

gene_anchor

A data.frame with gene, chr and anchor (an integer position per gene), or NULL (default). When given, rows are ordered by (chr, anchor, gene, category) instead of (chr, start, category), so that a gene's categories stay together when their spans differ (the non-coding masks); a gene absent from the table falls back to its row's start. See noncoding_gene_anchor.

reference_cutoffs

A data.frame with category, cutoff and derivation, or NULL (default): published constants printed beside the computed cutoffs in thresholds (the category "all" for the across-family one). They are never applied.

Value

A named list (the four table names below take type_label in place of coding):

glow_coding_all

Genome-wide GLOW table (gene x category), with the *_glowG rename and label, chr, category fronted.

staar_coding_nospa_all, staar_coding_spa_all

Genome-wide native tables per mode (0-row schema-only data.frame if a mode found nothing or is not requested).

coding_merged

One row per (gene, category): the four method columns plus each source's sub-tests and count columns, sorted gene-first.

coding_sig_by_category

Per (category, method): n_tested, thresholds, and significant-cell counts.

coding_sig_by_category_cells

One row per significant (gene, category) cell, gene-first, with every method's p-value, the count chain, a global GLOW rank, and the significance flags.

methods

The method columns present in coding_merged.

completeness

Character vector reconciling expected vs present GLOW chromosomes and native array tasks (the completeness-report lines).

thresholds

One row per (method, category) and per (method, "all"): n_tested, the computed cutoff, how it was computed (cutoff_rule), and the reference constant with its derivation when reference_cutoffs gives one.

completeness_table

One row per requested chromosome: its status ("present", "empty results file" when every cell skipped or errored, "no results file" under allow_partial), the cells (rows) and genes, the tested cells of the primary test and the rows whose primary p-value is missing, the cells attempted, ok, skipped (n_skip_empty, n_staar_skip_single) and errored read from <prefix>_chr<N>_summary.csv when that sidecar exists (the non-coding type; NA otherwise), and the error rows read from <prefix>_chr<N>_errors.csv when that file exists (NA otherwise).

Details

Three sources.

  1. GLOW – the per-chromosome glow_coding_chr*.csv row-bound genome-wide. The two baked-in STAAR omnibus columns on GLOW's exact post-filter genotype matrix (STAAR_O, ACAT_O) are renamed STAAR_O_glowG / ACAT_O_glowG so the merge can tell them from the native engine's STAAR_O_native.

  2. native non-SPA – the results-staar-nospa/staar_coding_*.csv per array-task tables row-bound (columns suffixed _native).

  3. native SPA – the results-staar-spa/staar_coding_*.csv per array-task tables row-bound (columns suffixed _spa).

Merge. GLOW is the base: it emits a cell for every \(\ge 1\)-variant gene; native only for \(\ge 2\)-variant cells, so native \(\subseteq\) GLOW. A left join from GLOW captures every real cell; native cells with no GLOW row are reported category-aware – a cell in a GLOW-tested category is WARNED (a genuine extraction mismatch), one in a standard category this run's GLOW set does not test is INFO (expected: native always emits all 7 standard masks).

Significance (computed at runtime, never hardcoded). For each (category, method) with \(n_{tested} > 0\) finite p-values, the per-category Bonferroni cutoff is \(\alpha / n_{tested}\) and the genome-wide cutoff is gw_alpha; counts of cells clearing each are tallied. The significant-cells table lists every (gene, category) cell that any present method makes significant (its per-(category, method) Bonferroni cutoff, looked up from the counts table, or gw_alpha).

Completeness. The number of expected vs present GLOW chromosomes and native array tasks is reconciled; allow_partial = FALSE (default) stops on any gap (a missing chr/task distorts the significance denominators), TRUE downgrades it to a warning and proceeds on what is present.

Gene-first output. coding_merged and coding_sig_by_category_cells are sorted by (chr, gene_start, category) – one block per gene at its genomic position with its categories underneath. glow_coding_all, staar_coding_nospa_all and staar_coding_spa_all keep their (chr, start[/gene], category) order.

References

Li, X., Li, Z., Zhou, H., et al. (2020). Dynamic incorporation of multiple in silico functional annotations empowers rare variant association analysis of large whole-genome sequencing studies at scale. Nature Genetics, 52, 969-983. doi:10.1038/s41588-020-0676-4

Li, Z., Li, X., Zhou, H., et al. (2022). A framework for detecting noncoding rare-variant associations of large-scale whole-genome sequencing studies. Nature Methods, 19, 1599-1611. doi:10.1038/s41592-022-01640-x

See also

aggregate_scan_results(), run_scan_unit(), build_scan_regions()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
agg <- aggregate_coding_results(
  output_dir       = "runs/maf0.5_snv_7cat/outputs",
  chroms           = 1:22,
  gene_num_in_array = 500,
  staar_modes      = c("spa", "nospa"))
head(agg$coding_merged)
agg$coding_sig_by_category

# The gene-centric non-coding masks: the same function pointed at the
# glow_noncoding_chr*.csv tables, the across-family cutoff computed from the
# tested cells (family_alpha / n_all) and the rows ordered by the gene anchor.
# staar_modes = character(0) reads no native STAARpipeline tables; the
# comparator columns inside the GLOW tables (STAAR_O_glowG, ACAT_O_glowG)
# are kept either way.
tbl <- do.call(rbind, lapply(1:22, function(k) utils::read.csv(
  sprintf("runs/myrun/outputs/results-glow/glow_noncoding_chr%d.csv", k),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE, colClasses = c(chr = "character"))))
nc <- aggregate_coding_results(
  output_dir        = "runs/myrun/outputs",
  chroms            = 1:22,
  gene_num_in_array = 500,
  staar_modes       = character(0),
  result_prefix     = "glow_noncoding",
  type_label        = "noncoding",
  family_alpha      = 0.05,
  gene_anchor       = noncoding_gene_anchor(tbl))
nc$thresholds
nc$completeness_table
} # }
